translations.web: Now therefore listen to their voice. However you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”
translations.bsb: Now listen to their voice; but you must solemnly warn them and show them the manner of the king who will reign over them.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them, and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
translations.asv: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit thou shalt protest solemnly unto them, and shalt show them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
